language_save_failed: Failed to save the interface language.
settings_language_description: Language of menus, buttons and messages. Saved to your account.
settings_events_description: The kinds of dates you can track, and how often each comes around. Birthday and Anniversary are built in, repeat every year, and cannot be deleted. Add your own, repeating as often as you like: every year, every month, every 37 days, every 5 years.
settings_password_description: Change the password you use to sign in.
settings_password_sso: You sign in through SSO, so there's no password on this account.
settings_notifications_description: Set up a channel to get reminders on the day of a birthday or anniversary. Click a channel to configure it.
settings_notify_time_help: The time of day, in your instance's configured timezone, to send a reminder on the day of any date with notifications turned on. Applies across every enabled channel.
settings_device_notifications_descriptio: Get notifications on this device, even when Candlr isn't open in a tab.
settings_shares_description: Read-only web links to your calendar that work without logging in. Each one shows only the event types you picked, and never notes. Create one from the Share button on the Calendar page. Deleting a link stops it working straight away.
settings_import_export_description: Download every card and date as a file, or add cards from one. Photos are not included.
settings_import_drop_hint: Drop a CSV, JSON or vCard file here, or click to choose
settings_file_format_csv: CSV has one row per date with the columns name, type, month, day, year, notes, notify, address. Rows with the same name become one card. year and notes can be blank, and a date column (1990-04-12 or 04-12) can replace month, day and year. A blank type uses your first event type.
settings_file_format_json: JSON is the same data grouped by person: {example}.
settings_file_format_merge: Importing merges into what you already have. A name that matches an existing card only gains the dates it is missing, and event types that don't exist yet are created, so importing an export twice changes nothing.
settings_carddav_description: Keep your cards in step with a CardDAV address book such as Radicale, Baïkal or Nextcloud. Birthdays and anniversaries are pulled in regularly. The address book is the master copy: names and dates are overwritten by the next sync, while your notes and reminder settings stay. Photos are not synced.
settings_carddav_hint: Use the address book's own URL, not the server's front page. If your server offers app passwords, use one.
settings_data_description: Permanently deletes every person and date you're tracking. Your account and settings are kept. This cannot be undone.
settings_danger_description: Permanently delete your account and all of its data. This cannot be undone.
settings_carddav_disconnect_description: Syncing stops. The cards it created stay as ordinary cards unless you choose to delete them.
settings_carddav_delete_cards: Also delete the cards that were synced
settings_delete_share_description: Anyone with this link will no longer be able to see the calendar. This cannot be undone.
settings_delete_event_type_description: This also deletes every date tracked under this type. This cannot be undone.
settings_delete_events_description: This permanently deletes every person and date you're tracking. Your account and settings are kept. This cannot be undone.
settings_delete_account_description: This permanently deletes your account and all of its data. This cannot be undone.
settings_cadence_hint: Dates of this type count from their start date, so they need a full date including the year.
settings_interval_invalid: Repeat interval must be a whole number from 1 to 1000
settings_test_sent: Test sent, check your device or app.
settings_webpush_not_configured: Device notifications aren't configured on this server.
settings_webpush_unsupported: This browser doesn't support device notifications.
settings_reorder_failed: Could not save the new order.
settings_share_delete_failed: Could not delete the shared calendar
twofactor_scan_instructions: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter its code to finish setup. Setup expires in 10 minutes.
twofactor_qr_alt: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app
twofactor_save_codes_description: Each code can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator. These codes are only shown now. Store them somewhere safe.
twofactor_sso: You sign in through SSO. Manage two-factor authentication in your identity provider's account settings.
twofactor_not_enabled: Add an authenticator code to protect your sign-in.
twofactor_download_header: Candlr recovery codes (each code works once)
events_empty: No dates yet. Add the first one to get started.
events_no_results: No matching names. Try another search or clear it to see all cards.
events_address_placeholder: For sending a card or gift (optional)
events_year_unknown: I don't know (or don't want to enter) the year
image_editor_hint: Drag the photo to reposition it, use the slider to zoom.
events_bulk_type_message: Applies to the {cards} selected. Dates of other types are left alone.
events_bulk_notify_message: Turn reminders on or off for every date on the {cards} selected.
events_bulk_delete_message: This permanently deletes them along with all of their dates. This cannot be undone.
events_bulk_none: No dates of that type on the selected cards
events_cadence_hint_strict: Repeats {cadence}, counting from this date. The year is required.
events_photo_save_partial: Name and dates saved, but the photo could not be saved. {error}. Try saving again.
person_synced: Synced from your address book. Name, dates and address follow it.
person_delete_card_message: This permanently deletes {name} and all of their dates.
dashboard_no_events_last_7_days: No events in the last 7 days.
dashboard_no_events_next_30_days: No events in the next 30 days.
dashboard_no_dates_yet: No dates yet. Add the first one to get started.
calendar_share_intro: Create a link that shows a read-only calendar to anyone who has it, without logging in. Notes are never shared. Manage or delete links in Settings.
calendar_no_event_types: You have no event types yet.
calendar_show_ages_hint: Shows "Turns 37" style labels. Off keeps birth years out of the link.
calendar_show_addresses_hint: Shows each card's address to anyone with the link. Off keeps it private.
calendar_share_created_note: Anyone with this link can see the dates you shared, so only send it to people you trust. Delete it in Settings to stop sharing.
calendar_feed_intro: Get every birthday and anniversary in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Thunderbird or any app that can subscribe to an iCal link. It stays up to date as you add cards.
calendar_feed_privacy: Anyone with this link can see your dates, so keep it private. Google Calendar (Other calendars, From URL) can only reach it if your Candlr address is available from the internet.
calendar_feed_hint: A new link or turning it off stops the current link from working.
calendar_select_event_type: Select at least one event type to share
calendar_copy_failed: Could not copy, select the link and copy it manually
calendar_feed_rotated: New link created. Subscribe again with it, the old one no longer works.
admin_add_user_intro: Creates an account directly. This bypasses the registration-enabled and max-users settings.
admin_delete_warning: This permanently deletes their account and all of their data. This cannot be undone.
auth_registration_closed_sso: Registration is closed. Use {provider} to sign in instead.
auth_registration_disabled: Registration is currently disabled on this instance.
auth_2fa_intro: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app, or use one of your recovery codes.
auth_forgot_intro: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link.
auth_forgot_unavailable: Password reset isn't available on this instance.
auth_forgot_sent: If that email is registered, a reset link has been sent. Check your inbox.
auth_hero_text: Candlr keeps track of everyone's birthdays in one place, and reminds you before they happen.
about_description: Candlr is an open-source, self-hosted birthday calendar. It keeps track of everyone's birthdays and anniversaries in one place, and reminds you on the day.
about_built_with: Built with Astro, FastAPI, and SQLite.
oidc_no_code: No authorization code returned by provider.
oidc_invalid_state: Invalid state parameter. Please try logging in again.
shared_link_dead: This link is no longer shared, or it was mistyped.
